setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Patterns 1 and 2 are both assigned to channel 1, with the same trigs on the same steps: pattern 1's notes are 2 steps long and pattern 2's are 4 steps long. Length merge is on Average, shown by the dim button at (16,8). Length merge is set with K1 (shift) held, which turns the velocity merge button (16,8) into the length button.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8). Average is the mean of the two lengths, 2 and 4, so each merged note lasts 3 steps (0.5 s).
steps.title: Average length merging

steps.caption: Hold K1 and tap (16,8) once. The button lights brighter and Length mode on the screen reads UP, which is the manual's Longer: the mean plus the gap between the lengths. Without K1 the same button sets the velocity merge instead.
steps.title: Choose Longer

steps.caption: Tap Play. 3 + 2 = 5 steps (0.83 s), longer than either source: overlapping, legato notes. Use Longer for pads that run into each other.
steps.title: Longer length merging

steps.caption: Hold K1 and tap (16,8) again. The button changes again and Length mode reads DOWN, the manual's Shorter: twice the shortest length minus the mean.
steps.title: Choose Shorter

steps.caption: Tap Play. 2 x 2 - 3 = 1 step (0.17 s): short, staccato notes. Use Shorter for tight plucks.
steps.title: Shorter length merging

steps.caption: Hold K1 and tap (16,8) once more: Length mode reads AVERAGE. The modes cycle Average, Longer, Shorter and back: tap Play and the notes last 3 steps again.
steps.title: Return to Average
